thread:
carla: Heads-up — I'm landing a docs PR for the Private installer that changes the routing example when using on-prem + cloud fallback for KMS. Need eyes on the network section: the current snippet implies SNAT on the gateway which breaks HSM mTLS.

matt: thanks, can you paste the snippet you changed? I remember we had an earlier convo about preserving client IP for HSM auditing.

carla: pasted below — original: ```iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE``` new suggestion: ```# prefer CNI SNAT only for external egress, preserve src for host-network to HSM
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -m comment --comment "egress-proxy" -j MASQUERADE
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.0.0.0/16 -d 192.168.200.0/24 -j RETURN```

omar: quick note — RETURN won't work unless the conntrack path expects a later rule; for nftables people this is confusing. Maybe show both iptables and nft examples.

carla: good call. adding nft example as well: ```nft add rule ip nat postrouting ip saddr 10.0.0.0/16 ip daddr 192.168.200.0/24 counter accept
nft add rule ip nat postrouting oifname "eth0" counter masquerade```

pr-bot: PR #2147 updated by carla — docs/private/installer/networking.md — diff: +42 -10 — reviewers assigned: matt, sophie

sophie: I'm on it. Also we should clarify the SDK sample — people forget to enable TLS client certs when hitting an HSM-backed KMS endpoint. Can you add a minimal SDK snippet?

carla: added this to the PR comments: ```python
from redwood_sdk import PrivateClient
client = PrivateClient(kms_endpoint="https://kms.example.internal:8443",
                       client_cert=("/etc/certs/client.crt","/etc/certs/client.key"),
                       verify="/etc/certs/ca.crt")
# ensure certificate CN maps to service principal in HSM
```

matt: looks fine. One more: the installer preflight needs to check that /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward is enabled and that nftables/iptable rules don't PREVENT host-network->HSM traffic. Could we add a small command to preflight?

carla: adding this checklist item: ```sh
# preflight: verify forwarding and basic route
sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo "ip_forward disabled"
ip route get 192.168.200.10
# or nftables users: nft list ruleset | grep -E "postrouting|masquerade"
```

omar: for HSM customers on air-gapped installs we should mention time sync — HSM certs expire/require accurate time. Suggest adding NTP guidance in the same section.

carla: good point — added a short note about chrony and 1-2 recommended NTP peers for sealed installs (and a reminder to not leak public NTP if fully isolated).

sophie: small editorial: the link to the HSM plugin PKCS#11 page was broken (404). Carla, can you swap to the canonical internal guide link? I left the correct URL in the PR comment.

pr-bot: comment on PR #2147: "linkfix: replaced /hsm-plugin/ with /integrations/hsm/pkcs11/"

matt: also, on the rolling upgrade note — call out an explicit canary path: spin up 1 node with passthrough KMS routing enabled, verify sign/verify with HSM, then flip the rest. People miss the “drain and cordon” detail.

carla: added a 3-step checklist under "Migration from cloud-KMS". Quick summary in the PR: 1) deploy 1 canary node with KMS passthrough; 2) run healthcheck script (link included); 3) Cordon/drain and roll remaining nodes.

sophie: thanks — lgtm from docs side once pr-bot green. @matt can you do a quick review on the iptables->nft wording?

matt: will do later today. If any of you want to test locally, here's a tiny script I use to emulate routing to an HSM on a bridged network: ```sh
# test-hsm-routing.sh
sudo ip netns add testns
sudo ip link add veth-host type veth peer name veth-ns
sudo ip link set veth-ns netns testns
sudo ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev veth-host
sudo ip netns exec testns ip addr add 10.0.0.2/24 dev veth-ns
sudo ip netns exec testns ip route add default via 10.0.0.1
# run your HSM emulator on host 192.168.200.10 and test from namespace
sudo ip netns exec testns curl -v https://192.168.200.10:8443/health --resolve "192.168.200.10:8443:192.168.200.10" --cert client.crt --key client.key
```

carla: perfect — I'll attach the script to the PR and ping infra for a quick smoke test on staging. Thanks everyone! :tada: 

pr-bot: PR #2147 CI: docs/lint passed, linkcheck failed (1 broken link) — see PR comments

carla: fixing the link now and will merge once linkcheck goes green. If anyone spots wording that could be misinterpreted for sealed/offline installs, shout here.

omar: minor nit — change "preserve src" to "preserve source IP for HSM auditing". More explicit for auditors.

carla: done. merging after green checks.

sophie: thanks — extra brownie points if we can add a tiny diagram (ASCII ok) to show packet flow for onprem->HSM through gateway. People always skip the diagrams.

carla: making an issue to add diagram to the private installer README and linking from the PR.

matt: noted — will review post-merge for any runtime caveats.

carla: merged — closing thread.
